correctness.rationale: The index lower bound is the standard coordinate norm estimate; Fourier/Walsh flat columns and Bessel prove sharpness for p>=2. If k exceeds dimension, equality forces k biorthogonal unit columns, impossible. In real dimension three with k=p=3,2 respectively, equality forces a 3x3 signed Hadamard matrix: sign averaging and equality in Cauchy imply every entry flat and the Gram matrix diagonal, contradiction. Finite dimensional compactness turns nonattainment of equality into strict infimum. The embedded program replayed on its actual source path and returned VERIFY_OK checks=19847; this does not replace analytic proof.
